---
title: "Inline code"
engine: er2
format: html
---

```{er2}
#| include: false
sym x
p = nextprime(10^20)
f = (x + 1)^2
```

The prime is `{er2} p`, which has `{er2} len(str(p))` digits.

Inline code sees the state at its own position: `{er2} 6*7`, and exact
arithmetic applies: `{er2} 1/3 + 1/6`.

In LaTeX, $f =$ `{er2} latex(f)`.

A fenced block must not be evaluated:

```markdown
The prime is `{er2} p`.
```

After the block, substitution still works: `{er2} 2^10`.

A code span that shows a fence, ` ```{er2} `, is not an expression, and
neither is ``` `{er2}` ``` on its own.
